description: This file defines a React functional component named CampaignTable that renders a sortable table displaying campaign performance metrics, including campaign name, status, platform, spend, impressions, clicks, CTR, conversions, and ROAS. It imports utility functions for formatting currency, numbers, and percentages, as well as icon components for sorting indicators.

methods.name: handleSort
methods.description: Handles sorting logic when a table header is clicked, toggling sort direction or changing the sort field.

methods.name: getSortIcon
methods.description: Returns the appropriate sort icon component based on current sort field and direction.

methods.name: getStatusBadge
methods.description: Returns a styled badge element indicating the campaign's status.
